traceability.notes:
The story 010.3-DEV-MIGRATE-TO-SUPPORTS has been fully implemented. The `prefer-implements-annotation` rule exists, is disabled by default, and when enabled emits optional recommendation warnings for `@story` + `@req` usage with a configurable severity. It provides auto-fix behavior that converts a single `@story` plus one or multiple `@req` lines into a single `@supports` line, and detects complex/multi-story patterns it cannot safely auto-fix, emitting appropriate warnings instead.
Tests explicitly tagged to this story validate: - Optional warnings and auto-fix (REQ-OPTIONAL-WARNING, REQ-AUTO-FIX, REQ-SINGLE-STORY-FIX) - Detection of non-auto-fixable multi-story scenarios (REQ-MULTI-STORY-DETECT) - Configuration behavior and default-off severity (REQ-CONFIG-SEVERITY) - Backward compatibility where legacy annotations remain valid (REQ-BACKWARD-COMP-VALIDATION)
Complementary validation rules and integration tests show that auto-fixed `@supports` annotations are syntactically and semantically valid, fulfilling the quality and coexistence requirements. With all relevant tests passing in the latest run, all acceptance criteria for this story are satisfied.
